name: Stillgate
summary: Lockdown software for the shared visitor PCs at American Space Dushanbe.
description: Visitor PCs boot straight into a locked screen. The registration desk unlocks a PC for a set time from a manager app; the visitor then sees a start screen with only the allowed programs and websites, and the PC locks itself again when time is up.
Offline-first on the local network, with TLS certificate pinning, HMAC challenge-response login per PC, a scrypt-hashed restore password and hardened Electron apps.

name: Password Manager
summary: A zero-knowledge password manager: the server never sees a password, only ciphertext.
description: A multi-client monorepo: a FastAPI backend, a React Native / Expo app, and a browser extension and CLI on the way.

Every vault entry is encrypted on-device with AES-256-GCM before it leaves the client, and login uses a key derived from the master password that can't be reversed into it. A fully compromised server leaks nothing usable.

name: Future Flow
summary: Earn your scroll time: an AI future-self coach that gates social media on verified progress.
description: An Android app where an AI "future you" turns who you want to become into skills and daily plans.
It verifies the work with real evidence — GitHub diffs, maths answers checked by a CAS, reading logs — and pays out social-media time from an event-sourced ledger that a native guard enforces.

name: Spotlight
summary: A mobile-first platform bridging physical and digital fashion.
description: Brands publish drops; buyers receive a digital twin of their purchase to tag, display and share across their profile and posts.
Real-time sync, offline support and a content feed inspired by modern streaming platforms.

name: Karevan
summary: A full-stack fintech web app, built as a team.
description: Authentication, real-time chat with optimistic UI updates, and a responsive design.
My part: the backend on Supabase — auth, the data model and the real-time chat.
